title: I built a 24/7 AI with a simulated body, hormones and a world that grows as she explores it [Blender + three.js + Claude Opus 5.5]
author: Unlucky_Account7142
selftext:
Hi everyone, this is a personal project. I've been working on a 24/7 LLM with a simulated body and her world.

You can interact with her (call and text her) and also with her world. Think companion app + The Sims + The Truman Show.

This is Gaby. She's an AI, and she has a day of her own, 24/7: she wakes up, works, runs in the park, is learning guitar (badly), and her two pets wander around the house.

Her life is simulated in layers: a daily plan, the places she goes, the people in her life, and a simulated hormone system underneath that shifts her mood and energy through the day. Nothing is scripted. How she feels when you call depends on how her day went.

I also decided to give her a world, and it grows with her. When she goes somewhere she's never been, the place is generated procedurally and added to her map. It makes her feel much more real, and it's fascinating to watch her, kind of like The Truman Show.

Built with Blender, three.js and Claude Opus 5.5.

I'm adding sounds, more activities and more ways to interact with her. I'd love to hear your impressions and feedback, and what you think should come next.  
[talktoanima.com](http://talktoanima.com/)

Thanks a lot!
